text: Thank god you're here! Some crazy guy has Sinthia held hostage. He's threatening to kill her! You've got to help.
source_text:
Thank god you're here! Some crazy guy has Sinthia held
 hostage. He's threatening to kill her! You've got to help.

text: Oh, geez, I hope you can do it. He's in her room. Help her!
source_text: Oh, geez, I hope you can do it. He's in her room. Help her!

text: You are an incredibly cold person. She could die without your help.
source_text: You are an incredibly cold person. She could die without your help.

text: All right, don't harp on me. I'll look into it.
source_text: All right, don't harp on me. I'll look into it.

text: Thank you for helping Sinthia. She's usually not a problem. You deserve a good night's sleep. On me. But don't ask for another freebie.
source_text:
Thank you for helping Sinthia. She's usually not a problem.
 You deserve a good night's sleep. On me. But don't ask
 for another freebie.

text: Enjoy your stay. Don't be a pain.
source_text: Enjoy your stay. Don't be a pain.

text: You should have saved Sinthia. It's your fault she died. I hope you are happy with yourself.
source_text:
You should have saved Sinthia. It's your fault she died. I
 hope you are happy with yourself.

text: Welcome to the Crash House. How can I help you, stranger?
source_text: Welcome to the Crash House. How can I help you, stranger?

text: I need a good night's sleep.
source_text: I need a good night's sleep.

text: Yeah, we serve your kind, too. It'll be $25 for the night. A week will cost you $150.
source_text:
Yeah, we serve your kind, too. It'll be $25 for the night.
 A week will cost you $150.

text: Yeah, you too. Have a good day.
source_text: Yeah, you too. Have a good day.

text: Okay, thanks. Your room is room #1. Follow me. Don't be shooting any guns in here, okay?
source_text:
Okay, thanks. Your room is room #1. Follow me. Don't be
 shooting any guns in here, okay?

text: You need some money before I can rent you a room.
source_text: You need some money before I can rent you a room.

text: Then you should try the Skum Pitt. I heard you can get a lot of water in your booze there.
source_text:
Then you should try the Skum Pitt. I heard you can get a lot
 of water in your booze there.

text: I don't know about that, but I will rent you a room. It's a good place to rest and heal up. $25 for a day, or a week is $150. Most people go for the weekly rate. You should, if you ask me.
source_text:
I don't know about that, but I will rent you a room. It's a good place
 to rest and heal up. $25 for a day, or a week is $150. Most people go for
 the weekly rate. You should, if you ask me.

text: I'm just a hotel manager, bub. Don't ask too much of me.
source_text: I'm just a hotel manager, bub. Don't ask too much of me.

text: Here's $50, tell me what you know.
source_text: Here's $50, tell me what you know.

text: I know you're $50 poorer. I don't do the gossip thing, okay? Come back if you want a room.
source_text:
I know you're $50 poorer. I don't do the gossip thing, okay?
 Come back if you want a room.

text: What do you think I am? A fool? If you're gonna bribe me, have enough money.
source_text:
What do you think I am? A fool? If you're gonna bribe me,
 have enough money.

text: Welcome back, what can I do for you?
source_text: Welcome back, what can I do for you?

text: I want to rent a room.
source_text: I want to rent a room.

text: You're already renting room #1 from me. Do you want me to show you where it is?
source_text:
You're already renting room #1 from me. Do you want me to show
 you where it is?

text: And this is still your room. Have a good stay.
source_text: And this is still your room. Have a good stay.

text: You know the drill. One day is $25. One week is $150.
source_text: You know the drill. One day is $25. One week is $150.

text: Sure. It's $25 a day, or $150 for the entire week.
source_text: Sure. It's $25 a day, or $150 for the entire week.

text: Okay. Room #1 is yours. Have a nice stay.
source_text: Okay. Room #1 is yours. Have a nice stay.

text: I want to rent a room.
source_text: I want to rent a room.

text: I don't like your face. I don't think I'll be renting you a room.
source_text: I don't like your face. I don't think I'll be renting you a room.

text: I really need a place to stay.
source_text: I really need a place to stay.

text: Deal with it. Yes or no.
source_text: Deal with it. Yes or no.

text: Good. Here you go. Room #1. Have a nice night, check out time is 11 o' clock.
source_text:
Good. Here you go. Room #1. Have a nice night, check out
 time is 11 o' clock.

text: Nah, wasn't me. Really it wasn't.
source_text: Nah, wasn't me. Really it wasn't.

text: Get out! You're too dumb to realize what you did, but my life is hell now!
source_text:
Get out! You're too dumb to realize what you did, but my
 life is hell now!

text: You son of a bitch. I can't believe you killed him. He was a good man, and now I get all sorts of hell . . . get out, and don't come back.
source_text:
You son of a bitch. I can't believe you killed him. He was
 a good man, and now I get all sorts of hell . . .
 get out, and don't come back.

text: Yeah, whatever you say, but that's not what I heard. You'd better behave around here, or I'll get out ol' Betsy and ram some buckshot up your ass.
source_text:

text: It's late. I hope you aren't wasting my time.
